source_scope: Video-only independent observation. No candidate runtime or diagnostic data was consulted while creating this oracle.
method: Visual review of full-frame and cropped samples. Approximate turn boundaries cross-checked against the visible right-side ENEMY TURN / YOUR TURN medallion and its stable color (video pixels only). HP values read visually from corresponding leader HP shields. No inference of action identity, damage source or card text.
sampling_note: Turn-boundary start times are approximate (typically +/-0.75s); cinematic overlays and transient occlusion are excluded. HP anchors are instantaneous visible readings, not inferred continuous ranges.

quality_cautions: A non-game overlay temporarily occludes the screen near 25 seconds; not authoritative for HUD state.
Large spell/evolution animations mask portions of the HUD near 80-85, 100-110, 125-131, 149-156 and 168-172 seconds.
Card names and effect descriptions are not asserted when the compressed recording does not support legible confirmation.
Do not classify HP changes between anchors as false positives until compared with continuous frame evidence.

observed_contrast_sequences.description: bottom HP temporarily reaches 5 and later returns to 13
bottom HP rises from 7 to 12 and later returns to 7
top HP changes from 18 to 20 late in the match

unknown_fields: exact played card identifiers for each window
effects or sources causing leader HP changes
EP and SEP state at all decision anchors
candidate recommendation correctness before comparing the candidate output
whether any candidate window is CHAIN_OK
observation_scope: Independently AI-observed from the compressed gameplay recording; neither a certified human ground truth nor a direct target-device confirmation.
discrepancy_handling: Treat either side as potentially wrong. Reinspect exact source frames and adjacent stable frames before adjudication; if compressed text/HP is ambiguous request original video. Unresolved disagreements remain UNKNOWN, not NG or PASS.
hp_transient_guard_review: Inspect both false HP transient acceptance and false suppression of real consecutive heal/damage changes. Sampled values alone do not establish the complete causal sequence.
